aboutGame.title: What is Finish The Word?
paragraphs: Finish The Word is a fast-paced multiplayer word-chain party game on Roblox by Table Game X. Each round, players must say a word that starts with the last letter of the previous word — Poodle, Elephant, Turtle — with no repeats and a shrinking timer until only the sharpest brain remains.

Beyond the core word race, the game layers a pet-collection meta with special abilities, win streaks, cash rewards, and ranked lobbies. With tens of millions of visits and a 90% player rating, it has become one of Roblox's hottest word games of 2026.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Finish The Word.

items.question: What is Finish The Word?
items.answer: Finish The Word is a free-to-play multiplayer word-chain party game on Roblox by Table Game X. Players take turns saying a word that starts with the last letter of the previous word, with no repeats, until the timer knocks everyone else out.

items.question: How do rounds work in Finish The Word?
items.answer: In Finish The Word, each player says one new word that starts with the last letter of the previous word. Reused words are invalid, and failing to answer before the timer ends eliminates you from the round.

items.question: Does Finish The Word have redeem codes?
items.answer: As of July 2026, Finish The Word has no verified active codes. Progression comes from winning rounds, building streaks, earning cash, and collecting pets. Watch the Roblox game page and Table Game X group for future announcements.

items.question: What do pets do in Finish The Word?
items.answer: Pets in Finish The Word grant special in-round abilities. Hatch them from eggs, unlock more through lucky blocks and spins, then equip the ones that help you survive longer in tough lobbies.

items.question: How do win streaks work in Finish The Word?
items.answer: Win streaks in Finish The Word reward consecutive round victories with more cash and progression. Protect your streak with careful word picks and pet abilities, and look at streak-focused game passes if you farm ranked lobbies often.
